acceptanceCriteria: A documented make target or script trims the Go build caches Corvint uses (the default GOCACHE, CORVINT_GOCACHE /tmp/corvint-go-build-cache, and /tmp/corvint-work-queue-gocache-<uid>) to a stated size or age bound, and deletes nothing but those caches.

The trim runs automatically at a bounded point (for example after make gate, or when a cache exceeds its bound) or the gate runbook names when to run it; the chosen bound and trigger are recorded in the spec or runbook.
Leftover go-build* work directories under the temp root that are older than a stated age are covered by the same step, and a directory in use by a running build is never removed.
body: Filed 2026-09-26 (owner: "ticket the cache trim"). The host disk filled (2.7 GiB free of 1.8 TiB): ~/Library/Caches/go-build held 88 GiB, /tmp/corvint-go-build-cache (Makefile CORVINT_GOCACHE, also used by script/dogfood-change.sh and script/dogfood-bind-range.sh) held 40 GiB, and /tmp held 386 go-build* work directories (4.5 GiB, 289 older than a day) from interrupted builds. Go never trims its cache by size, only entries unused for about five days, and every full gate in a fresh clone adds a large set of distinct entries. go clean -cache on the default cache freed 85 GiB. Add a bounded, cache-only trim so repeated gates and release evidence runs cannot exhaust the disk.

completion.reason: DONE per 2026-10-21 v1-0 ticket audit, independently verified against origin/main ef2a01db5: a6511480d, d5bc69bbc; script/go-cache-trim.sh; docs/LANE-ORCHESTRATION.md:173-176. 20 GiB bound, trigger, 24h work dirs, in-use guard documented

title: Go build caches grow without bound and filled the host disk; add a bounded cache trim
